common.sentence: 친구가 온 후에 영화를 볼 거예요.

language_specific.morphology: 오- + -ㄴ + 후 + 에 forms 온 후에. The friend's arrival precedes the planned viewing.

common.meaning: from, marking the start of a time range

language_specific.morphology: 아홉 시+부터: 부터 attaches to the starting time.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 아홉 시부터 열한 시까지: from nine until eleven.

common.meaning: since, marking when an ongoing activity began

language_specific.morphology: 지난주+부터: 부터 attaches to the starting time.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 지난주부터 한국어를 배우다: learn Korean starting from last week.

language_specific.morphology: 다음 달+부터: 부터 attaches to the future starting time 달.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 다음 달부터 배울 거예요: will start learning next month.

common.meaning: from, marking the start of a route

language_specific.morphology: 서울역+부터: 부터 attaches to the starting station.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 서울역부터 부산역까지: from Seoul Station to Busan Station.

common.sentence: 잘 못 들었어요. 처음부터 다시 말해 주세요.
common.meaning: from, marking the point at which something is restarted

language_specific.morphology: 처음+부터: 부터 attaches to 처음, the beginning.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 처음부터 다시 말하다: say it again from the beginning.

common.meaning: starting with, marking the first item in an order

language_specific.morphology: 책+부터: 부터 attaches to the first item, 책.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 이 책부터 읽다: read this book first.

common.meaning: first, marking an action's object as the starting priority

language_specific.morphology: 밥+부터: 부터 attaches to 밥, the object of 먹어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 밥부터 먹다: eat first.

common.meaning: starting with, marking the first person in an order

language_specific.morphology: 저+부터: 부터 attaches to 저, the first person to take a turn.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 저부터 하다: I will go first.

common.sentence: 새 학기부터 매일 일기를 쓸 거예요.

language_specific.morphology: 학기+부터: 부터 attaches to the noun marking the starting time.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 새 학기부터: starting with the new school term.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 학기부터 [학끼부터]. The initial ㄱ of 기 is tense after ㄱ.

common.sentence: 개강부터 지금까지 수업에 빠진 적이 없어요.

language_specific.morphology: 개강+부터: 부터 attaches to the noun marking the start of classes.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 개강부터 지금까지: from the start of classes until now.

common.meaning: from, marking the first day of a recurring range

language_specific.morphology: 월요일+부터: 부터 attaches to the first day in the range.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 월요일부터 금요일까지: from Monday through Friday.

language_specific.morphology: 시청+부터: the particle 부터 attaches to the noun 시청 to mark the route's starting point.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 시청부터 역까지: from city hall to the station.

common.meaning: from, marking the first page in an inclusive range

language_specific.morphology: 삼 쪽+부터: 부터 attaches to 쪽, the first page in the range.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 삼 쪽부터 오 쪽까지: pages three through five.

language_specific.morphology: 입원+부터: 부터 attaches to the noun marking the start of the period.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 입원부터 [이붠부터]. The final ㅂ links to the following vowel.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 입원부터 퇴원까지: from admission to discharge.

common.meaning: starting on, marking the first day of an event

language_specific.morphology: 다음 주 화요일+부터: 부터 attaches to the starting day 화요일.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 화요일부터 시작하다: start on Tuesday.

language_specific.morphology: 출발점+부터: 부터 attaches to the noun marking the spatial starting point.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 출발점부터 뛰다: run from the starting point.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 출발점부터 [출발쩜부터]. ㅈ is tense after ㄹ in this Sino-Korean compound.

language_specific.morphology: 첫차+부터: 부터 attaches to the noun marking the start of the service period.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 첫차부터 [첟차부터]. Final ㅅ is pronounced ㄷ before ㅊ.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 첫차부터 막차까지: from the first bus through the last.

common.meaning: from, marking the beginning of a spatial range

language_specific.morphology: 입구+부터: 부터 attaches to the starting location.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 입구부터 출구까지: from the entrance to the exit.

common.meaning: starting from, marking the start of a contrasted period

language_specific.morphology: 주+부터+는: 부터 marks the starting time, and 는 marks the period as a topic.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 이번 주부터는: starting this week, as a contrast with before.

common.meaning: starting from, marking the first position to look at

language_specific.morphology: 줄+부터: 부터 attaches to the starting row.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 두 번째 줄부터 보다: look starting with the second row.

common.meaning: until, marking when a continuing activity ended

language_specific.morphology: 밤 열 시+까지: 까지 attaches to the endpoint 시.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 열 시까지 공부하다: study until ten.

language_specific.morphology: 금요일+까지: 까지 attaches to the deadline.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 금요일까지 숙제를 내다: submit the homework by Friday.

common.meaning: to, marking the endpoint of a stated route

language_specific.morphology: 공항+까지: 까지 attaches to the route endpoint.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 공항까지 가다: go as far as the airport.

common.meaning: until, marking the end of a period extending to now

language_specific.morphology: 지금+까지: 까지 attaches to the endpoint 지금.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 아침부터 지금까지: from this morning until now.

common.meaning: as far as the four-way intersection

language_specific.morphology: 사거리+까지: 까지 attaches to the noun marking the endpoint.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 사거리까지 가다: go as far as the four-way intersection.

common.sentence: 일 번부터 십 번까지 답을 쓰세요.
common.meaning: through, including the final numbered item

language_specific.morphology: 십 번+까지: 까지 attaches to 번, the last number in the range.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 일 번부터 십 번까지: numbers one through ten.

common.meaning: until, marking the end of a continuing stay

language_specific.morphology: 다음 주+까지: 까지 attaches to the endpoint 주.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 다음 주까지 집에 있다: stay home until next week.

language_specific.morphology: 마감일+까지: the particle 까지 attaches to the noun 마감일 to mark a deadline.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 마감일까지 [마가밀까지]. The final consonants link to the following vowel-initial syllables.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 마감일까지 신청서를 내다: submit an application by the deadline.

language_specific.morphology: 종점+까지: 까지 attaches to the noun marking the endpoint.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 종점까지 가다: go to the terminal stop.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 종점까지 [종쩜까지]. The initial consonant of 점 is tense in this compound.

common.meaning: through, marking the final day of a closure

language_specific.morphology: 일요일+까지: 까지 attaches to the final day.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 일요일까지 쉬다: be closed through Sunday.

language_specific.morphology: 여기+까지+만: 까지 marks the endpoint, and 만 restricts the reading to that point.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 여기까지만 읽다: read only up to here.

language_specific.morphology: 삼 층+까지: 까지 attaches to 층, the endpoint.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 삼 층까지 올라가다: go up to the third floor.

language_specific.morphology: 막차+까지: 까지 attaches to the noun marking the end of the wait.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 막차까지 기다리다: wait until the last bus.

language_specific.morphology: 모레+까지: the particle 까지 attaches to the noun 모레 to mark a deadline.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 모레까지 예약을 마치다: finish the reservation by the day after tomorrow.

language_specific.morphology: 중간+까지: 까지 attaches to the noun marking the endpoint.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 영화 중간까지 보다: watch a movie up to the middle.

common.meaning: to, marking the end of something

language_specific.morphology: 끝+까지: 까지 attaches to 끝, the end.
language_specific.pronunciation: Sentence: '끝까지' [끋까지]. The final consonant of 끝 is pronounced [ㄷ] before 까지.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 끝까지 듣다: listen to the end.

common.sentence: 표는 한 사람에 네 장까지 살 수 있어요.
common.meaning: up to, marking an inclusive quantity limit

language_specific.morphology: 네 장+까지: 까지 attaches to 장, the quantity limit.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 네 장까지 살 수 있다: can buy up to four tickets.

common.sentence: 이번 달까지는 이 방을 쓸 수 있어요.
common.meaning: through, marking the end of a contrasted period

language_specific.morphology: 달+까지+는: 까지 marks the endpoint, and 는 marks the period as a topic.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 이번 달까지는: through this month, with a contrast concerning the later period.

common.meaning: to, marking the destination of a journey

language_specific.morphology: 정류장+까지: 까지 attaches to the destination.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 다음 정류장까지 얼마나 걸리다: how long it takes to reach the next stop.

common.meaning: by, marking a deadline before an event

language_specific.morphology: 전+까지: 까지 attaches to 전, the time before the meeting.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 회의 전까지 보내다: send by the time before the meeting.

language_specific.morphology: 버스+보다: attach the comparative particle 보다 to the noun serving as the comparison base.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 버스보다 지하철이 빠르다: the subway is faster than the bus. This 보다 marks comparison; it is distinct from the verb 보다 and the trial auxiliary 보다.

language_specific.morphology: 커피+보다: attach the comparative particle 보다 directly to the noun, without an object particle.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 커피보다 차를 자주 마시다: drink tea more often than coffee.

language_specific.morphology: 저+보다: attach the comparative particle 보다 to the pronoun 저.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 저보다 먼저 일어나다: get up earlier than I do.

language_specific.morphology: 어제+보다: attach the comparative particle 보다 to the time word 어제.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 어제보다 오늘이 더 바쁘다: today is busier than yesterday.

common.sentence: 이 길은 저 길보다 덜 복잡해요.

language_specific.morphology: 덜 + 복잡하- + -여요 → 덜 복잡해요: 덜 means less, and 하여요 contracts to 해요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 길이 복잡하다: a road is congested or busy.

language_specific.morphology: 푹신하- + -여요 contracts to 푹신해요.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 푹신해요 [푹씬해요]. The ㅅ is pronounced tense after ㄱ.

language_specific.morphology: 안전하- + -여요 → 안전하여요 → 안전해요.
튼튼하- + -여요 → 튼튼하여요 → 튼튼해요.
부드럽- + -어요 becomes 부드러워요: the ㅂ irregular stem changes ㅂ to 우 before the vowel ending.
빳빳하- + -여요 contracts to 빳빳해요.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 빳빳해요 [빧빠태요]. The final ㅅ before ㅎ combines with it as ㅌ.
Target: 얇아요 [얄바요]. The final ㅂ moves to the following vowel-initial syllable.

language_specific.morphology: 쉽- + -어요 becomes 쉬워요: the ㅂ irregular stem changes ㅂ to 우 before the vowel ending.
엄격하- + -여요 contracts to 엄격해요.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 엄격해요 [엄껴캐요]. The ㄱ at the start of 격 is tense, and its final ㄱ combines with ㅎ as ㅋ.
Target: 밝아요 [발가요]. The final ㄱ moves to the following vowel-initial syllable.

language_specific.morphology: 선명하- + -여요 → 선명하여요 → 선명해요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 사진이 선명하다: a photo is clear and sharp.

language_specific.morphology: 저렴하- + -여요 contracts to 저렴해요.

common.sentence: 저는 동생보다 물을 더 많이 마셔요.

language_specific.morphology: 더 + 많이: 더 marks a greater degree and 많이 is the adverb meaning in a large quantity.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 물을 더 많이 마시다: drink a greater quantity of water.

language_specific.morphology: 덜 + 읽어요: 덜 means less, and 읽어요 is the informal polite present of 읽다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 책을 덜 읽다: read books less.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 읽어요 [일거요]. The ㄱ of the ㄺ cluster links to the following vowel.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 일찍 자다: go to bed early.

language_specific.morphology: 늦- + -게 forms the adverb 늦게, describing the time of departure.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 늦게 [늗께]. The final consonant is pronounced ㄷ and the following ㄱ is tense.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 늦게 출발하다: depart late.
운동을 꾸준히 하다: exercise consistently.

language_specific.morphology: 조심하- + -여서 → 조심하여서 → 조심해서; it describes doing the following action with care.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 말을 조심해서 하다: speak carefully.
자주 요리하다: cook often; 보다 supplies the comparison.
운동을 열심히 하다: exercise diligently.

common.sentence: 이 가방이 저 가방보다 훨씬 가벼워요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 보다 훨씬 가볍다: be much lighter than the comparison base.

common.sentence: 오늘 더 추워요? 어제보다 오히려 따뜻해요.
이 방은 저 방보다 두 배 넓어요.

language_specific.morphology: 두 + 배: 두 is the form of 둘 used before the counter 배.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 보다 두 배 넓다: be twice as large in area as the comparison base.

common.sentence: 이 차는 저 차보다 천 원 더 비싸요.

language_specific.morphology: 천 원 + 더: the amount precedes 더 to state the size of the price difference.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 천 원 더 비싸다: cost 1,000 won more.

common.sentence: 오늘은 어제보다 한 시간 더 잤어요.

language_specific.morphology: 한 시간 + 더: 한 is the form of 하나 used before 시간; 더 marks the additional duration.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 한 시간 더 자다: sleep one hour longer.

language_specific.morphology: 생각+보다: the comparative particle attaches to 생각, referring to what one thought or expected.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 생각보다 쉽다: be easier than expected.

language_specific.morphology: 예상+보다: the comparative particle attaches to 예상, an expectation or prediction.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 예상보다 많다: be more numerous than anticipated.

language_specific.morphology: 계획+보다: the comparative particle attaches to 계획, the plan used as a reference.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 계획보다 [계획뽀다/게훽뽀다]. The ㅂ of 보다 is tense after the final ㄱ of 획.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 계획보다 일찍 도착하다: arrive earlier than planned.

language_specific.morphology: 늘- + -었어요 forms 늘었어요, the informal polite past of 늘다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 수입이 늘다: income increases.

language_specific.morphology: 줄- + -었어요 forms 줄었어요, the informal polite past of 줄다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 지출이 줄다: spending decreases.

language_specific.morphology: 더 + 좋아하- + -여요 → 더 좋아하여요 → 더 좋아해요: 더 marks a greater degree.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 채소를 더 좋아하다: like vegetables more.
품질이 중요하다: quality matters.

common.sentence: 이 표가 저 표보다 할인 폭이 커요.

language_specific.morphology: 할인 + 폭: the noun 할인 specifies the reduction measured by 폭.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 할인 폭이 크다: the discount is large.

language_specific.morphology: 편리하- + -여요 → 편리하여요 → 편리해요.

common.sentence: 이 식당은 저녁보다 아침에 빈자리가 많아요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 빈자리가 많다: there are many available seats.

common.sentence: 이 가게는 저 가게보다 물건이 다양해요.

language_specific.morphology: 다양하- + -여요 contracts to 다양해요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 물건이 다양하다: the goods are varied.

language_specific.morphology: 솜 + 처럼: the resemblance particle 처럼 attaches directly to the noun.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 솜처럼 하얗다: be white like cotton.

language_specific.morphology: 수정 + 처럼: the resemblance particle 처럼 attaches directly to the noun.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 수정처럼 맑다: be clear like crystal.

language_specific.morphology: 화살 + 처럼: the resemblance particle 처럼 attaches directly to the noun.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 화살처럼 날아가다: fly like an arrow.

language_specific.morphology: 별 + 처럼: the resemblance particle 처럼 attaches directly to the noun.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 별처럼 생기다: be shaped like a star.

language_specific.morphology: 천사 + 처럼: the manner particle 처럼 attaches directly to the noun.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 천사처럼 자다: sleep like an angel.

language_specific.morphology: 깃털 + 처럼: the resemblance particle 처럼 attaches directly to the noun.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 깃털처럼 가볍다: be light like a feather.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 깃털처럼 [긷털처럼]. The final ㅅ of 깃 is pronounced ㄷ before 털.

language_specific.morphology: 설탕 + 처럼: the resemblance particle 처럼 attaches directly to the noun.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 설탕처럼 달다: be sweet like sugar.

language_specific.morphology: 동화 + 처럼: the resemblance particle 처럼 attaches directly to the noun.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 동화처럼 아름답다: be beautiful like a fairy tale.

language_specific.morphology: 로봇 + 처럼: the manner particle 처럼 attaches directly to the noun.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 로봇처럼 걷다: walk like a robot.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 로봇처럼 [로볻처럼]. The final ㅅ is pronounced as ㄷ before 처럼.

language_specific.morphology: 금속 + 처럼: the resemblance particle 처럼 attaches directly to the noun.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 금속처럼 빛나다: shine like metal.

language_specific.morphology: 언니 + 처럼: 처럼 attaches directly to the noun 언니.

common.meaning: as; in the same way as

language_specific.morphology: 어제 + 처럼: 처럼 attaches directly to 어제.
장미 + 처럼: 처럼 attaches directly to the noun 장미.
친구 + 처럼: 처럼 attaches directly to the noun 친구.
천둥+처럼: 처럼 attaches to the noun and marks a resemblance.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 천둥처럼 소리가 크게 나다: make a loud sound like thunder.

language_specific.morphology: 사람 + 처럼: 처럼 attaches directly to the noun 사람.
유리+처럼: 처럼 attaches to the noun and marks a resemblance.

common.meaning: ate, drank, or took, with subject honorification

language_specific.lexical_frame: 말을 사람에게 전달하다: pass a message on to someone.

common.sentence: 저는 여행 중에 큰 어려움을 겪었어요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 어려움을 겪다: experience a difficulty.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 겪었어요 [겨꺼써요]. The stem-final ㄲ links to the vowel ending, and past ㅆ is heard as the onset of 써.

language_specific.social_context: The speaker uses subject honorification for their grandmother.
language_specific.morphology: 지내- + -시어요 contracts to 지내세요, from 지내다; -시- marks subject honorification.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 친구와 헤어지다: part from a friend.
language_specific.morphology: 헤어지- + -었어요 contracts to 헤어졌어요, from 헤어지다.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 헤어졌어요 [헤어저써요]. Past ㅆ links to the vowel ending as the onset of 써.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 이름이 기억나다: a name comes to mind.
language_specific.morphology: 기억나- + -아요 contracts to 기억나요, from 기억나다.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 기억나요 [기엉나요]. Final ㄱ assimilates to ㅇ before ㄴ.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 고향을 떠올리다: bring one's hometown to mind.
language_specific.morphology: 떠올리- + -었어요 contracts to 떠올렸어요, from 떠올리다.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 떠올렸어요 [떠올려써요]. Past ㅆ links to the vowel ending as the onset of 써.

language_specific.morphology: 익숙하- + -여요 contracts to 익숙해요, from 익숙하다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 동네가 익숙하다: a neighborhood is familiar to someone.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 익숙해요 [익쑤캐요]. ㅅ becomes tense after ㄱ, and ㄱ combines with ㅎ as ㅋ.
Target: 낯설어요 [낟써러요]. The final consonant of 낯 is pronounced before the tense ㅆ sound.

language_specific.morphology: 알아보- + -았어요 contracts to 알아봤어요, from 알아보다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 사람을 알아보다: recognize a person.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 알아봤어요 [아라봐써요]. ㄹ links to the following vowel, and past ㅆ links as the onset of 써.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 사람을 반갑게 맞다: greet someone warmly.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 맞았어요 [마자써요]. ㅈ links to the first vowel ending, and past ㅆ links as the onset of 써.

language_specific.morphology: 떠오르- + -았어요 becomes 떠올랐어요: the 르 irregular adds ㄹ to the preceding syllable and changes 르 to 라.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 이름이 떠오르다: a name comes to mind spontaneously.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 떠올랐어요 [떠올라써요]. Past ㅆ links to the following vowel as the onset of 써.

language_specific.morphology: 자세하- + -여요 contracts to 자세해요, from 자세하다.
정확하- + -여요 contracts to 정확해요, from 정확하다.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 정확해요 [정화캐요]. ㄱ combines with ㅎ as aspirated ㅋ.

language_specific.morphology: 적당하- + -여요 contracts to 적당해요, from 적당하다.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 적당해요 [적땅해요]. ㄷ becomes tense after ㄱ.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 초등학생에게 알맞다: be suitable for elementary school students.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 알맞아요 [알마자요]. ㅈ links to the vowel ending.

language_specific.morphology: 편안하- + -여요 contracts to 편안해요, from 편안하다.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 두 사진의 차이: the difference between two photos.
두 사람의 공통점: a point shared by two people.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 공통점 [공통쩜]. The initial consonant of 점 is pronounced tense in this compound.

common.sentence: 이 집은 역과 가까워요. 이것이 장점이에요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 집의 장점: an advantage of a home.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 장점 [장쩜]. The initial consonant of 점 is pronounced tense in this compound.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 가방의 단점: a drawback of a bag.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 단점 [단쩜]. The initial consonant of 점 is pronounced tense in this compound.

language_specific.morphology: 선택하- + -였어요 contracts to 선택했어요.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 선택했어요 [선태캐써요]. The final ㄱ combines with ㅎ to produce an aspirated ㅋ sound.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 두 메뉴 중에서 비빔밥을 선택하다: choose bibimbap from two menu items.

common.sentence: 할 일이 많아요. 우선 밥부터 먹어요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 대신 물을 마시다: drink water in place of the unavailable tea; 대신 is a noun used adverbially.

common.sentence: 오래 기다렸지만 결국 버스가 안 왔어요.

language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 직접 [직쩝]. ㅈ becomes tense after ㄱ.

common.sentence: 내일 바빠서 오늘 미리 짐을 쌌어요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 가족과 함께: together with one's family.

common.sentence: 사진 속 집은 작아요. 실제로 집이 더 커요.

language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 실제로 [실쩨로]. In this word, ㅈ is pronounced as tense ㅉ.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 만약 비가 오면: if it rains.
당장 출발하다: leave right away; 당장 is a time noun used adverbially.
